_comment: Human-editable utility rate knobs. prepare_inputs.py expands these into the QuESt-format input_data/rate_structure.json (12x24 weekday/weekend schedules). Rates are Ontario RPP Time-of-Use (CAD/kWh) as provided for this project. Set plan to 'ulo' to use the Ultra-Low Overnight plan, or 'flat' for a single energy rate.
name: Ontario RPP Time-of-Use
_demand_charge_note: Ontario RPP TOU has no demand charge; set a $/kW value here if the site is on a General Service / demand-billed tariff to value peak-demand reduction.

net_metering._credit_mode_note: 'flat' = NEM 1.0: exports credited at a single sell price (realistic for Ontario; no grid-charge-to-export arbitrage). 'retail' = NEM 2.0: exports credited at the full retail TOU rate (can overstate value by enabling price arbitrage).
